name: @cera/ui
//exports: Subpath exports rather than one barrel. A barrel means importing Button pulls in every component and, more importantly, defeats tree-shaking in apps/web - the whole library ends up in the first-load bundle of every route.

scripts.//lint: Whole package, not just src. The pre-commit hook lints staged files wherever they are, so a script scoped to src/ lets the hook fail on a file the package's own lint call never looked at - which is how vitest.setup.ts reached a commit with a parse error.

//peerDependencies: A range, not the catalog pin. The catalog resolves to an exact version, and an exact peer range makes any React patch bump in apps/web report an unmet peer for a library that is built from source in the same repository.
